passages.text: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet us in battle at Edrei.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They turned and went up the road toward Bashan.
Og was the king of Bashan.
Og gathered his whole army.
Og and his army came out to meet the Israelites.
They came to fight a battle.
The battle took place at Edrei.
passages.original: וַנֵּ֣פֶן וַנַּ֔עַל דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן וַיֵּצֵ֣א עוֹג֩ מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֨ן לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ ה֧וּא וְכָל־ עַמּ֛וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֶדְרֶֽעִי׃

passages.text: But the LORD said to me, “Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, along with all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD spoke to me.
The LORD said, “Do not be afraid of Og.”
Og is king of Bashan.
The LORD said, “I have given Og into your hand.”
The LORD said, “I have given all his people into your hand.”
The LORD said, “I have given his land into your hand.”
The LORD said, “Treat Og as you treated Sihon.”
Sihon is king of the Amorites.
Sihon lived in Heshbon.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֣א אֹת֔וֹ כִּ֣י בְיָדְךָ֞ נָתַ֧תִּי אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ אַרְצ֑וֹ וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ לְסִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: So the LORD our God also delivered Og king of Bashan and his whole army into our hands. We struck them down until no survivor was left.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD gave Og into our hands.
Og was the king of Bashan.
The LORD also gave all of Og’s people into our hands.
We struck Og and his people down.
We did not leave any survivor.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֜ינוּ בְּיָדֵ֗נוּ גַּ֛ם אֶת־ ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֖ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּ֑וֹ וַנַּכֵּ֕הוּ עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ שָׂרִֽיד׃

passages.text: At that time we captured all sixty of his cities. There was not a single city we failed to take—the entire region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
passages.sermon:
Moses led Israel at this time.
God gave Israel victory over Og, king of Bashan.
We captured all his cities at that time.
We took sixty cities in total.
We did not leave a single city untaken.
We captured the entire region of Argob.
This region belonged to the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
passages.original: וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־ כָּל־ עָרָיו֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ לָקַ֖חְנוּ מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִיר֙ כָּל־ חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃

passages.text: All these cities were fortified with high walls and gates and bars, and there were many more unwalled villages.
passages.sermon:
These cities had strong defenses.
Each city had high walls.
Each city had gates.
Each city had bars on the gates.
There were also many villages without walls.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה עָרִ֧ים בְּצֻר֛וֹת חוֹמָ֥ה גְבֹהָ֖ה דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּבְרִ֑יחַ לְבַ֛ד מֵעָרֵ֥י הַפְּרָזִ֖י הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: We devoted them to destruction, as we had done to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children of every city.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites fought against the people of Bashan.
They destroyed the people in every city.
They killed all the men in each city.
They killed all the women in each city.
They killed all the children in each city.
They did this just as they had done to Sihon, king of Heshbon.
They devoted every city and its people to destruction.
passages.original: וַנַּחֲרֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ינוּ לְסִיחֹ֖ן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן הַחֲרֵם֙ כָּל־ עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם הַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּֽף׃

passages.text: But all the livestock and plunder of the cities we carried off for ourselves.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites attacked the Amorite cities.
They destroyed the people in those cities.
They did not destroy the animals.
They took all the livestock for themselves.
They also took all the plunder from the cities for themselves.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֛ה וּשְׁלַ֥ל הֶעָרִ֖ים בַּזּ֥וֹנוּ לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: At that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land across the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon— which the Sidonians call Sirion but the Amorites call Senir— all the cities of the plateau, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as the cities of Salecah and Edrei in the kingdom of Og.
passages.sermon:
At that time, we took land from the two kings of the Amorites.
These kings ruled across the Jordan River.
We took the land from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon.
The Sidonians call Mount Hermon "Sirion."
The Amorites call Mount Hermon "Senir."
We took all the cities on the plateau.
We took all of Gilead.
We took all of Bashan.
We took land as far as Salecah and Edrei.
Salecah and Edrei are cities in the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
passages.original: וַנִּקַּ֞ח בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִוא֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מִיַּ֗ד שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִנַּ֥חַל אַרְנֹ֖ן עַד־ הַ֥ר חֶרְמֽוֹן׃ צִידֹנִ֛ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לְחֶרְמ֖וֹן שִׂרְיֹ֑ן וְהָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י יִקְרְאוּ־ ל֖וֹ שְׂנִֽיר׃ כֹּ֣ל׀ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֗ר וְכָל־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן עַד־ סַלְכָ֖ה וְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃

passages.text: (For only Og king of Bashan had remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. His bed of iron, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)
passages.sermon:
Og was the king of Bashan.
Og was the only one left from the remnant of the Rephaim.
Og had a bed made of iron.
People can still see his bed in Rabbah, the city of the Ammonites.
The bed is nine cubits long.
The bed is four cubits wide.
These measurements use the standard cubit of a man.
passages.original: כִּ֣י רַק־ ע֞וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן נִשְׁאַר֮ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִים֒ הִנֵּ֤ה עַרְשׂוֹ֙ עֶ֣רֶשׂ בַּרְזֶ֔ל הֲלֹ֣ה הִ֔וא בְּרַבַּ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן תֵּ֧שַׁע אַמּ֣וֹת אָרְכָּ֗הּ וְאַרְבַּ֥ע אַמּ֛וֹת רָחְבָּ֖הּ בְּאַמַּת־ אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: So at that time we took possession of this land. To the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the land beyond Aroer along the Arnon Valley, and half the hill country of Gilead, along with its cities.
passages.sermon:
At that time, we took possession of this land.
This land stretched from Aroer, which is by the Arnon Valley.
I gave this land to the tribe of Reuben and the tribe of Gad.
I gave them half of the hill country of Gilead.
I also gave them the cities in that region.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את יָרַ֖שְׁנוּ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑וא מֵעֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֗ן וַחֲצִ֤י הַֽר־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעָרָ֔יו נָתַ֕תִּי לָרֻֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְלַגָּדִֽי׃

passages.text: To the half-tribe of Manasseh I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og. (The entire region of Argob, the whole territory of Bashan, used to be called the land of the Rephaim.)
passages.sermon:
Moses led the Israelites.
Og was king of Bashan.
Og ruled over Bashan.
Og was a remnant of the Rephaim.
Moses gave land to the tribes.
Moses gave the rest of Gilead to the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Moses gave all of Bashan to the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Bashan was the kingdom of Og.
The region of Argob was part of Bashan.
People called all of Bashan the land of the Rephaim.
passages.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר הַגִּלְעָ֤ד וְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁן֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת ע֔וֹג נָתַ֕תִּי לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כֹּ֣ל חֶ֤בֶל הָֽאַרְגֹּב֙ לְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן הַה֥וּא יִקָּרֵ֖א אֶ֥רֶץ רְפָאִֽים׃

passages.text: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites. He renamed Bashan after himself, Havvoth-jair, by which it is called to this day.
passages.sermon:
Jair was a descendant of Manasseh.
Jair took the whole region of Argob.
This land reached as far as the border of the Geshurites.
It also reached as far as the border of the Maacathites.
Jair renamed Bashan after himself.
He called it Havvoth-jair.
People still use this name today.
passages.original: יָאִ֣יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לָקַח֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב עַד־ גְּב֥וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְהַמַּֽעֲכָתִ֑י וַיִּקְרָא֩ אֹתָ֨ם עַל־ שְׁמ֤וֹ אֶת־ הַבָּשָׁן֙ חַוֺּ֣ת יָאִ֔יר עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: To Machir I gave Gilead, and to the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead to the Arnon Valley (the middle of the valley was the border) and up to the Jabbok River, the border of the Ammonites.
passages.sermon:
Machir was a leader from the tribe of Manasseh.
I gave Gilead to Machir.
The Reubenites were people from the tribe of Reuben.
The Gadites were people from the tribe of Gad.
I gave land to the Reubenites and Gadites.
This land started at Gilead.
It reached to the Arnon Valley.
The middle of the Arnon Valley was the border.
The land also reached up to the Jabbok River.
The Jabbok River was the border of the Ammonites.
passages.original: וּלְמָכִ֖יר נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃ וְלָרֻאוּבֵנִ֨י וְלַגָּדִ֜י נָתַ֤תִּי מִן־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַד־ נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן תּ֥וֹךְ הַנַּ֖חַל וּגְבֻ֑ל וְעַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַנַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The Jordan River in the Arabah bordered it from Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ) with the slopes of Pisgah to the east.
passages.sermon:
The Jordan River marked the border in the Arabah region.
This border stretched from Chinnereth.
It reached to the Sea of the Arabah.
The Sea of the Arabah is also called the Salt Sea.
The border ran below the slopes of Pisgah.
These slopes lay to the east.
passages.original: וְהָֽעֲרָבָ֖ה וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן וּגְבֻ֑ל מִכִּנֶּ֗רֶת וְעַ֨ד יָ֤ם הָֽעֲרָבָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח תַּ֛חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָה׃

passages.text: At that time I commanded you: “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess. All your men of valor are to cross over, armed for battle, ahead of your brothers, the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people at that time.
He gave them a command.
The LORD is your God.
The LORD has given you this land.
You are to take this land and possess it.
All your fighting men must go ahead of your fellow Israelites.
Your men of valor must cross over, ready for battle.
passages.original: וָאֲצַ֣ו אֶתְכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם נָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־ הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ חֲלוּצִ֣ים תַּֽעַבְר֗וּ לִפְנֵ֛י אֲחֵיכֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ חָֽיִל׃

passages.text: But your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—may remain in the cities I have given you, until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as He has to you, and they too have taken possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them across the Jordan. Then each of you may return to the possession I have given you.”
passages.sermon:
Your wives may stay in the cities I have given you.
Your children may also stay in these cities.
Your livestock may remain there too.
I know you have much livestock.
They will stay in these cities I have given you.
They will stay until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, just as He gave rest to you.
Your brothers will also take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving them across the Jordan.
After that, each of you may return to your own possession that I have given you.
passages.original: רַ֠ק נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם וְטַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵכֶם֒ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי־ מִקְנֶ֥ה רַ֖ב לָכֶ֑ם יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶֽם׃ עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר־ יָנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֥ה׀ לַֽאֲחֵיכֶם֮ כָּכֶם֒ וְיָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם־ הֵ֔ם אֶת־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְשַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ לִֽירֻשָּׁת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And at that time I commanded Joshua: “Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader who would succeed Moses.
At that time, I gave Joshua a command.
I said to Joshua, "You have seen with your own eyes what the LORD your God did to these two kings."
The LORD defeated these two kings before Israel.
The LORD your God will do the same to all the kingdoms where you are going.
The LORD will defeat those kingdoms for you, just as He did before.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ יְהוֹשׁ֣וּעַ צִוֵּ֔יתִי בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר עֵינֶ֣יךָ הָרֹאֹ֗ת אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ לִשְׁנֵי֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כֵּֽן־ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְכָל־ הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ר שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: Do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God Himself will fight for you.”
passages.sermon: Do not be afraid of them.\r\nThe LORD is your God.\r\nThe LORD Himself will fight for you.
passages.original: לֹ֖א תְִּירָא֑וּם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַנִּלְחָ֥ם לָכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: At that time I also pleaded with the LORD: “O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the LORD at that time.
Moses pleaded with the LORD.
Moses said, “O Lord GOD, You are showing Your greatness to me.
You are showing Your strong power to Your servant.
No god in heaven is like You.
No god on earth is like You.
No one can do the works You do.
No one can do mighty acts like Yours.”
passages.original: וָאֶתְחַנַּ֖ן אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹֽר׃ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אַתָּ֤ה הַֽחִלּ֙וֹתָ֙ לְהַרְא֣וֹת אֶֽת־ עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶ֨ת־ גָּדְלְךָ֔ וְאֶת־ יָדְךָ֖ הַחֲזָקָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִי־ אֵל֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כְמַעֲשֶׂ֖יךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses was God's servant and leader of Israel.
Moses said, "Please let me cross over the Jordan River."
Moses asked to see the good land on the other side.
Moses wanted to see the pleasant hill country.
Moses also wanted to see Lebanon.
passages.original: אֶעְבְּרָה־ נָּ֗א וְאֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן הָהָ֥ר הַטּ֛וֹב הַזֶּ֖ה וְהַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃

passages.text: But the LORD was angry with me on account of you, and He would not listen to me. “That is enough,” the LORD said to me. “Do not speak to Me again about this matter.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD became angry with me.
He was angry because of you.
The LORD did not listen to me.
The LORD spoke to me.
He said, “That is enough for you.
Do not speak to Me again about this matter.”
passages.original: וַיִּתְעַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה בִּי֙ לְמַ֣עַנְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ רַב־ לָ֔ךְ אַל־ תּ֗וֹסֶף דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י ע֖וֹד בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Go to the top of Pisgah and look to the west and north and south and east. See the land with your own eyes, for you will not cross this Jordan.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to go to the top of Pisgah.
God told Moses to look in every direction.
God told Moses to look west.
God told Moses to look north.
God told Moses to look south.
God told Moses to look east.
God told Moses to see the land with his own eyes.
God told Moses he would not cross the Jordan River.
passages.original: עֲלֵ֣ה׀ רֹ֣אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֗ה וְשָׂ֥א עֵינֶ֛יךָ יָ֧מָּה וְצָפֹ֛נָה וְתֵימָ֥נָה וּמִזְרָ֖חָה וּרְאֵ֣ה בְעֵינֶ֑יךָ כִּי־ לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: But commission Joshua, encourage him, and strengthen him, for he will cross over ahead of the people and enable them to inherit the land that you will see.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to give Joshua a command.
God told Moses to encourage Joshua.
God told Moses to make Joshua strong.
Joshua will lead the people.
Joshua will go ahead of the people.
Joshua will help the people take the land.
This is the land Moses will see.
passages.original: וְצַ֥ו אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְחַזְּקֵ֣הוּ וְאַמְּצֵ֑הוּ כִּי־ ה֣וּא יַעֲבֹ֗ר לִפְנֵי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהוּא֙ יַנְחִ֣יל אוֹתָ֔ם אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

passages.text: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
passages.sermon: The Israelites stayed in the valley.\r\nThe valley was across from Beth-peor.
passages.original: וַנֵּ֣שֶׁב בַּגָּ֔יְא מ֖וּל בֵּ֥ית פְּעֽוֹר׃פ
